ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface comprising approximately 85% of the visible area, with high-contrast low-intensity (black) boundaries along the trailing edge and peduncle.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity field across both lobes; low-intensity pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge, distal tips, and a vertical linear feature at the peduncle junction. Two distinct, vertically aligned low-intensity circular blobs are present on the upper central white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate interior angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (micro-peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased complexity and jaggedness at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the posterior margins of both lobes, transitioning to sharp upward tapers at the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two vertically aligned, high-contrast dark circular clusters located on the central white field near the median notch; smaller dark clusters visible along the posterior marginal boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, faint, horizontal linear pixel disruption is detectable traversing the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular erosion and jagged indentations on both distal tips; distinct vertical pair of focal pigmentation marks on the central axis.
other_distinctive_markers: Dark vertical stripe extending from the peduncle into the high-intensity central field, creating a bifurcation effect at the base.
